TOWER-v3 PARAGRAPH (replaces the stage-third branch story AND the 'open' sentence):
CORRECTION, then extension.  The previously reported third-order splitting of
the d=6 flex space into two branches was an artifact: the stage-third cubic
was assembled from integerized second-order witnesses J.H_ij = L_ij B(u_i,u_j)
with MIXED clearing factors L_ij (3 and 1 at x5; 5 and 1 at x13) used as if
uniform, so it was not the obstruction of any actual jet.  With the exact
canonical correctors Hhat_ij = H_ij/L_ij the TRUE third-order obstruction map
is IDENTICALLY ZERO: all 56 symmetrised cubic coefficients lie in range(J),
independently at x5=(3+4i)/5 and x13=(5+12i)/13; the mis-scaled coefficients
rebuilt deliberately reproduce the old nonzero pattern, pinning the artifact,
and the direction w3241+w3277 formerly declared obstructed is certified flat
by an independent route.  The correction propagates one order up with no
caveat: since the cubic vanishes identically, its derivative vanishes and the
fourth-order class C4(u) = [2B(u,h3)+B(h2,h2)] is fully well defined on
ker(J)/gauge -- and it, too, is IDENTICALLY ZERO: all 126 symmetrised quartic
coefficients lie in range(J) exactly at both points (flint solve on the
3039x3039 pivot subsystem, integer verification of every claim on all 6848
rows).  The d=6 excess flex is therefore unobstructed through FOURTH order in
every direction, with explicit exact jets x0 + tu + t^2 h2 + t^3 h3 + t^4 h4.
Part of the space is closed to ALL orders: the subspace <v_theta, w3241,
w3243> consists of integer phase-grading rotations, and a symbolic identity
(each joint weight class of each of the 3284 orthogonality products vanishes
coefficient-by-coefficient in X) exponentiates it to an exact 3-torus
(theta, s1, s2) through every point of the mechanism circle.  The
complementary subspace <v_theta, w3277, w3291, w3301> (meeting the torus
exactly in the circle: the six kernel vectors have rank 6) is support-
breaking -- its generators move zero entries, acting to leading order as an
X-weighted rank-one shear -- and whether it integrates beyond fourth order
remains open; a non-certified Newton continuation along it converges to
machine precision, so the honest expectation is a genuine analytic sheet.
